title: loxo yu alku
intro: Yaa ngi taxaw ci mbedd yu xawa jaxasoo yi ci Makkah, di barab bu nit ku am doole ak alal daa musa bàyyi wootu dëgg. Jaar-jaaru nit kii daf nuy fàttali ni lëkkaloo deret mënul daaneel buum gi. Kan mooy ki turam di yegg ci safara jiy xaar?
clues: Maa ngi dox ci mbeddi Màkka ak mbégte bu ma lëndëmloo ci dëgg, doonte ndaw si sama deret la bokk.
Samay moomeel bariwoon nañu lool, waaye nekkul woon luy mbugal, nekkul luy may sama bopp.
Téere tegtal bi dafay wax ci sama yàqu-yàqu, di wax ni samay loxo ak sama yaram dina ñu ñàkk.
Sama jabar dugg na ci sama kàmpaañu noonte, dajale dég ngir tasaare ko ci yoonu kiy woo Yàlla.
Bisu àtte ba, dina ñu ma dugal ci safara gu tàng, te sama jabar dina am buum bu ñu defaree fibre palme ci baat bi.
Ñu xamee ma ci tur wuy tekki 'baay xal' — tur wuy wax sama dëkkuwaay ba fàww.

trial.label: Jàngat bu am solo wala xew-xew
options: Dafa bañ Yonent bi, ñu alku ko ci Al Quran
Jiite woon ab soldaar ngir daaneel Kaaba gi
Di jéema ray yonent bi ci sànni ay xeer
Bañ gëm ni weer wi dafay xaajaloo
Tabax ab tour buy yegg ci asamaan si
trial.answer: Dafa bañ Yonent bi, ñu alku ko ci Al Quran

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Dana dugg ci safara su tàng, te alalam du ko jariñ.
Ñu baal ko ginaaw bimu bañee
outcome.answer: Dana dugg ci safara su tàng, te alalam du ko jariñ.

arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verse: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained. (111:2)
